12 key events are defined and 12 of them never fired. 4 are test events, and 4 lead events count every repeat submit.
Automatic events all fire and scroll shows from enhanced measurement. No lead or sign-up event fired. Custom event 'ExampleSaaS' (50 events) uses the brand name as its event name.
11 of 11 custom dimensions and 12 of 12 custom metrics got no values in 30 days; 8 are test definitions and 2 copy built-in dimensions.

top_5_fixes.fix: Find out why GA4 misses almost every visit
top_5_fixes.what_it_fixes: every report: 60 sessions recorded against 2000 Google clicks alone, 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-29
top_5_fixes.evidence: search_analytics: 2000 clicks over 29 days, 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-29 (the last day it returns); get_report sessionSource/sessionMedium for the same dates: google / organic = fewer than 10 sessions, 60 sessions in total
top_5_fixes.next_step: Check whether the consent banner defaults analytics to denied and how many visitors accept, and whether the tag loads on every page template. A consent choice is the visitor's; if that is the cause, accept lower counts or rely on modelled data rather than bypassing it.
top_5_fixes.who: the site code and consent banner

top_5_fixes.fix: Decide where sign-ups are measured, and measure them there
top_5_fixes.evidence: list_key_events: 12 defined, 12 never fired; pageReferrer: 10 events referred by app.example.com, hosts seen: example.com, www.example.com
top_5_fixes.next_step: If sign-ups happen in the app, tag the app with the same measurement id and add both domains to the cross-domain setting, or report sign-ups from the app's own analytics. Then mark the real sign-up event as a key event.
top_5_fixes.who: do this in GA4 Admin and the app code; I can mark the event as a key event once it fires

top_5_fixes.fix: Remove the test key events and count leads once per session
top_5_fixes.what_it_fixes: 4 test key events and 4 lead events that count repeat submits
top_5_fixes.evidence: list_key_events: test events site_qa_test_v1, qa_write_test_v2, site_qa_test_v2, qa_check_v3; ONCE_PER_EVENT lead events sign_up, book_demo, form_submit, site_demo_form_submit
top_5_fixes.next_step: Delete the test key events in GA4 Admin. Switch the lead events to ONCE_PER_SESSION.
top_5_fixes.who: I can change the counting now (update_key_event); deleting is done in GA4 Admin

top_5_fixes.fix: Keep bot traffic out of the reports
top_5_fixes.what_it_fixes: 20 of 60 sessions (37%), plus a provisional spike of 80 sessions yesterday
top_5_fixes.evidence: get_report country: Singapore 20 sessions, 0 engaged, 0.04s; Argentina fewer than 10 sessions, 0 engaged, 1.2s; get_report date: 2026-10-01 80 sessions vs median 2
top_5_fixes.next_step: Re-run the spike check in 2 days. If it holds, build reports on engaged sessions, and block the source at the site or CDN; GA4 has no setting to drop a country.

top_5_fixes.fix: Raise event data retention to 14 months
top_5_fixes.what_it_fixes: explorations and funnels limited to two months of history
top_5_fixes.next_step: Set it in GA4 Admin > Data collection and modification > Data retention. It is not retroactive.
